en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with tree‑lined streets, early automobiles and pedestrians. On the left stands a large domed church or former mosque with a tall bell tower, while grand historicist buildings line the right side of the street. At the bottom of the front image the captions read "Pécs" and "Széchenyi‑tér". The reverse side is blank, with a divided back for address and message, printer information, and a Hungarian copyright notice.
